Overview

yFiles for HTML 3.1 is a commercial browser diagramming SDK. Official documentation describes graph editing, interaction, keyboard and touch input, undo/redo, persistence, SVG/WebGL styles, graph analysis, filtering, and multiple automatic and incremental layout families. Threat semantics and human review remain application behavior.

Evidence used by RPT-0006

  • Release announcement: https://www.yworks.com/news

Applicability

Primary documentation for the commercial SDK option in Issue #10. It bears on no accepted decision in this record.

Limits

The evaluation package and license require customer-center access. RPT-0006 did not run the common fixture with yFiles, so the assessment remains documentation-only. Pricing and redistribution implications need scenario-specific review.
